waivers.reason: The fix ships in postcss 8.5.12, but next 15.5.x pins postcss at exactly 8.4.31 and an end-user install resolves next's own pin, so neither a direct dependency nor a workspace override reaches it; postcss runs only at build time, and the shipped dashboard is pre-built. Bump next once it requires a patched postcss.

The fix ships in postcss 8.5.18, but next 15.5.x pins postcss at exactly 8.4.31 and an end-user install resolves next's own pin, so neither a direct dependency nor a workspace override reaches it; postcss runs only at build time, and the shipped dashboard is pre-built. Bump next once it requires a patched postcss.

The fix ships in sharp 0.35.0, but next 15.5.x declares sharp ^0.34.x and an end-user install resolves next's own range, so neither a direct dependency nor a workspace override reaches it; the dashboard has no next/image usage, so sharp is never loaded at runtime. Bump next once it allows sharp >=0.35.0.
